atlases.name: rat
atlases.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: production pixel-art pet animation sprite sheet for the attached cat's game. Reference 1 is original cat, reference 2 baby cat: match their angular chunky silhouette and extremely economical flat pixels. Create ONE character atlas. Actual transparent background. EXACT layout: 8 columns and 10 rows = 80 individually separated sprites, regular grid, no text, no borders, no extra rows. Portrait 4:5 aspect. Each cell represents 32x32 logical pixels enlarged equally; subject fits roughly 18x18 logical pixels centered with generous clear margins. Pixel art is made of big square blocks on a consistent coarse grid. A continuous one-logical-pixel charcoal outline, solid light gray body, medium gray detail, tiny black square eyes; no tiny speckles, no gradients, no anti-aliasing, no shadow, no texture or decorative particles. Keep identity and size constant, each row is a sequence with 8 genuinely different frames. Rows TOP TO BOTTOM: 1 idle breathing/blinking; 2 looking; 3 grooming; 4 stretching; 5 walk cycle; 6 distinct faster run cycle; 7 asleep closed eyes; 8 curious sniff/tilt; 9 happy bouncing; 10 relaxed sit and settle. Fill ALL 80 cells. Keep paws/tail attached and entirely within each cell.
SUBJECT: ADULT RAT: clear long slim pink naked tail, rounded ears, pointed short snout, compact gray body, black eyes. Clean charcoal outline matching cat. Walk low to ground, quick scurry run, sniff and rise on hindlegs. Restrained pink only nose/ear/tail.
